input.quote: The Company shall have exclusive artistic and editorial control over the Site, including, without limitation, the implementation of the Content on the Site and the design and look and feel of the Site.
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no intellectual property or data ownership provision at all: HDI designs, develops and hosts the Site and holds the Company's Content, user information and data (p0048), yet nothing states who owns the Site deliverables, the Content or the customer/order data generated through the Site. Section 5.2 gives us only artistic and editorial control, Section 10.2 disclaims co-ownership only as to the relationship, and the confidentiality section protects but does not vest ownership. Under the IP rule we must own the deliverables and materials created for us, retain all rights in our Content, Marks and customer data, and avoid any implied assignment to or joint ownership with the Vendor, while HDI keeps its pre-existing platform subject to a licence-back. Proposed new Section 5.5 inserted after 5.4 supplies the preferred position with a minimal, self-contained clause; the fallback (HDI ownership of the build plus a perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free licence to us) is offered in the comment.

proposal.summary: Insert new Section 5.5 vesting ownership of the Site deliverables, Content and Site customer data in the Company, with HDI retaining its pre-existing platform and granting a licence-back, and no joint ownership.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement is silent on intellectual property, so we have added a short ownership section confirming that we own the Content, the Deerskin Marks, the Site materials developed for us and all customer and order data generated through the Site, with no assignment of our IP or data to HDI and no joint ownership. HDI keeps its pre-existing platform and tools and gives us a perpetual, royalty-free licence to anything of its embedded in the Site; if HDI prefers, we can instead leave ownership of the underlying build with HDI provided we receive that perpetual, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense the Site deliverables.

ops.text: 5.5 Ownership. As between the Parties, the Company owns and retains all right, title and interest in and to (i) the Content, the Marks and all other materials furnished by the Company, (ii) the Site, including its design, look and feel, and all work product, deliverables and materials developed by or for HDI specifically for the Site, and (iii) all customer, order and e-mail list data generated through the Site in respect of Deerskin Products, and HDI hereby assigns to the Company all right, title and interest it may have in the items described in clauses (ii) and (iii). HDI retains all right, title and interest in its pre-existing software, tools, systems and hosting platform, and hereby grants the Company a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense any such HDI materials to the extent incorporated in, or necessary for the operation of, the Site. Nothing in this Agreement assigns to HDI, or creates any joint ownership in, any intellectual property, Content or data of the Company.
